Subject: CAIQ control mapping & evidence sprint — next steps

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for sending over the initial CAIQ. I've attached a working control map (control_map_v2.xlsx) and an evidence_manifest.csv that lists what we currently have queued. Quick notes and a proposed plan: 

- Scope: we'll respond to the full CAIQ (v4.1) but flag a subset of controls for which we'll provide architecture-level artifacts only (tenant isolation, network segmentation, KMS boundaries).
- Timeline: propose a 7-business-day active sprint to collect artifacts and then a 3-day review window for Acme security.
- Owners: internal owners are listed in the spreadsheet — Karthik is primary for network/infra controls; Laura will coordinate policy + SOC2 overlap.

Can you confirm:
1) preferred evidence formats (PDF exports vs. original config files)?
2) whether Acme needs a formal attestation or just artifact links for the initial review?

Attachments: control_map_v2.xlsx (Excel, 124KB), evidence_manifest.csv (CSV, 22KB)

If that all looks good I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff with the owners and share a Drive folder + a short sprint board.

Best,
Jordan Blake

Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 11:02:14 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ control mapping & evidence sprint — next steps

Jordan —

Thanks for the quick turn. PDF exports are preferred for static artifacts; for configuration data we can accept JSON/CSV exports — we pull those into our tooling. For attestation: for the first pass, artifact links are fine. If things progress to procurement we may ask for a signed attestation or SOC2 report excerpt.

Two asks up front: 
- Please include a tenant isolation diagram showing VPC/NSG boundaries and where encryption keys are scoped.
- For KMS: tell us whether keys are customer-managed or centrally managed by Redwood; include KMS policy exports (an anonymized policy is fine).

I attached a short questionnaire we use to speed mapping (acme_caioq_questions.pdf). Also, our cloud-security reviewer (Cassie Choi) will be on the thread for any deep infra questions.

If you can give us the artifacts within 7 business days as proposed we should be able to complete our initial review within 3 business days.

Cheers,
Maya Rodgers
Head of Security Assurance — Acme Financial
security@acme-financial.com
